_comment: Hand-curated places that are regularly open. Every fact here was copied from the linked official page on the 'verifiedOn' date. On each refresh the script re-downloads the page and checks that every 'verifyText' snippet still appears; if not, the place is flagged 'hours may have changed'. Do not add facts that are not on the source page. Closure dates are listed on the source without a year; they are interpreted for the 2026-27 season.

places.title: Gary Halter Nature Center (Lick Creek Park)
places.description: A 2,400 square-foot nature center with an outdoor classroom, amphitheater, native plant displays and a monarch butterfly garden. It is the focal point of the city's 523-acre Lick Creek Park. Hours of operation include tours, open restrooms and office hours for reservations. The surrounding park's curfew is dawn to dusk.

location.name: Gary Halter Nature Center
location.address: 13600 Rock Prairie Road, College Station, TX 77845

places.hoursText: Daily, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. (nature center). Park curfew: dawn to dusk.
places.closuresText: Closed: Aug. 1-2, Sep. 5-7, Oct. 31, Nov. 26-29, Dec. 5-6, Dec. 21-31, Jan. 1-3

places.title: Lincoln Recreation Center
places.description: Originally the A&M Consolidated Negro School, the Lincoln Recreation Center has served as a neighborhood and cultural institution for more than 80 years. The facility includes two gymnasiums, a game room, a fitness room, multipurpose rooms, a splash pad and a 13,000-square-foot covered pavilion. The City page lists the splash pad as closed for construction.
places.closuresText: Closed: Aug. 1-2, Sep. 5-7, Nov., 26-29, Dec. 5-6, Dec. 21-31, Jan. 1-3

places.title: Meyer Senior & Community Center
places.description: The Bob and Wanda Meyer Senior and Community Center is focused as a place where seniors can socialize and enhance quality of life. The facility offers a variety of both passive and active programs and activities including line dancing, dominoes, colored pencil drawing, and more.
places.hoursText: Hours of operation: Mon.–Fri., 8 a.m.–5 p.m.
places.closuresText: Closed: Aug. 1-2, Sep. 5-7, Nov., 25-29, Dec. 5-6, Dec. 21-31, Jan. 1-3

places.title: Wolf Pen Creek Park & Trails
places.description: A 63-acre park with a paved 2.7-mile trail system and a 10-acre open festival site; home of the Wolf Pen Creek Amphitheater.
